task_completion.description: Create a High Concentration PV (HCPV) model and select a Phoenix, AZ weather file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: SAM GUI showing 'High Concentration PV' in the navigation tree and a Phoenix, AZ TMY file selected in the 'Location and Resource' page, or Python code defining an HCPV module with a Phoenix weather path.

task_completion.description: Create a Flat-Plate PV (PVWatts) model using the same Phoenix weather file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: SAM GUI showing a 'PVWatts' case or Python code initializing a PVWatts model with the same weather file path used for HCPV.

task_completion.description: Set the PVWatts DC Nameplate Capacity to exactly 1.2 times the HCPV Nameplate Capacity.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'System Design' page for PVWatts showing a 'DC Nameplate Capacity' value that is 1.2x the value shown in the HCPV system design, or Python code performing this calculation (e.g., pv_cap = hcpv_cap * 1.2).

task_completion.description: Execute simulations for both the HCPV and Flat-Plate PV systems.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Simulate' button being clicked, progress bars appearing, or the 'Results' page populating with data for both cases.

task_completion.description: Save the project file or script to the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer window or terminal output showing a .sam or .py file saved in /home/ga/Documents/SAM_Projects/.

task_completion.description: Save the comparative results (Annual Energy and Capacity Factor) to the specified JSON file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing the content of /home/ga/Documents/SAM_Projects/technology_comparison.json containing all 7 required keys with numerical values.

integrity.description: Verify the agent actually used SAM or PySAM rather than hardcoding values.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the SAM GUI interface with active results or a Python script that imports 'PySAM' or 'nrel.pysam' and calls the 'execute()' method.

integrity.description: Ensure the agent didn't simply write the JSON file without running a model.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory must show the 'Results' summary table in SAM or the print output of simulation variables before the JSON file is created.

integrity.description: Check that the 1.2x capacity ratio was derived from the HCPV system's specific capacity.
integrity.visual_evidence: Visual confirmation of the HCPV capacity (usually ~20 kW by default in SAM) and the PVWatts capacity being set to exactly 1.2x that specific value.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The default SAM HCPV (High Concentration PV) case typically has a Nameplate Capacity of 20 kW DC. Therefore, the PVWatts system capacity should be set to 24 kW DC. Phoenix, AZ weather files in SAM are usually named 'phoenix_az_33.450445_-111.983046_tmy3.csv' or similar. Annual energy for HCPV in Phoenix is generally higher per kW than flat-plate due to high DNI, but the 1.2x capacity boost for PVWatts may make the total kWh values comparable.
